technique "ScatteringTec0" mmdpass=object usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=0 empty=0 passes=3
  pass 0 "DrawStars" script=0 custom=1 psize15=0 shadermix=1

selection subsets=2 clamped=0
  # name! = the technique matched but is invalid (fallback); - = no technique
  # modes 0 and 1 list the eight Use* states: index = usetexture | usespheremap<<1 | usetoon<<2
  select object 0-1 "ScatteringTec0" "ScatteringTec0" "ScatteringTec0" "ScatteringTec0" "ScatteringTec0" "ScatteringTec0" "ScatteringTec0" "ScatteringTec0"

  select shadow 0-1 "ShadowTec"
  select edge 0-1 "EdgeTec"
  select zplot 0-1 "ZplotTec"
